artworks.title: The Abduction of Europa
artworks.description: Rembrandt's Europa carried west — the sister Cilix fails to find, leaving him to settle the Asian coast that takes his name as Cilicia.

artworks.title: Cadmus Goes in Search of His Sister Europa
artworks.description: Cadmus' search for Europa — the same Agenorid quest that strands Cilix in Asia Minor as eponym of Cilicia.

artworks.title: The Rape of Europa
artworks.description: Titian's Europa — Agenor's daughter whose abduction scatters Cadmus, Phoenix, and Cilix across the eastern Mediterranean.

popCulture.title: Cilix
popCulture.description: Son of Agenor who abandons the search for Europa and gives his name to Cilicia — the eponym as geographic residue.

popCulture.title: Cilicia
popCulture.description: The southern Anatolian region named for Cilix in classical aetiology — brother of Cadmus as map-label.

popCulture.title: Europa (consort of Zeus)
popCulture.description: Cilix's sister — the Phoenician princess whose abduction launches the brothers' failed quest.

popCulture.title: Agenor
popCulture.description: Cilix's father — the Tyrian king who sends his sons to recover Europa or never return.
